entry.other: Restricted zones around the Kosovo border crossings; landmines in the mountains along that border.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The official currency is the Denar (MKD). You can't change it outside North Macedonia. Declare foreign currency over 10,000 euros or equivalent on arrival. This covers all forms of currency, not only cash. If you don't, you could be detained and your money confiscated. In North Macedonia major hotels and most shops accept credit cards, however some smaller shops and green markets only accept cash. Most banks in towns and cities have ATMs that accept international bank cards.
